title: It's just ok
text: I've been thinking of cancelling, did it because I figured maybe they'll send something I don't have and wouldn't think about picking.  Like I said, it's ok.  My biggest complaint is that it drops in you orders and ships what seems like immediately and leaving you little to know time to cancel.  Some things i'd like to cancel since I already have it or I just plain really don't want it.  I understand that slowing the machine to ship something can be impossible so they should at least give you a heads up as to what is going to show up in your orders.  I haven't received anything that has wow'd me and giving it 3 stars since I can't give it 2.5.  Nice concept but needs some work.
label: neutral
